day.headline: A Monkey day — Rat and Dragon are in step.

reasons: Monkey's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: shoes that pinch on one side
signs.message: One shoe's pinching. Change them, then go do the ambitious thing.

reasons: Rat and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Your hair's doing something new and better. Leave it, go out.

reasons: Snake pairs with Monkey — a harmonious day
signs.motif: the second half of the day
signs.message: The afternoon's the good part today. Keep your best hour open.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: someone else taking the last one
signs.message: Someone grabbed the last one. Ask what else they've got.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the quiet hour before anyone arrives
signs.message: Nobody's in yet. Use that hour on the thing you dread.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Cut that unsent message down to two lines. Sit on it.

reasons: Dragon and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Show closes Sunday. Get the ticket booked before you forget.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a road being dug up again
signs.message: That street's torn up again. Budget ten extra minutes, no drama.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the free thing with a catch
signs.message: Free with strings attached. Read the catch, then pass.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a broken thing you keep anyway
signs.message: It's still broken, still yours. No decision required today.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Everyone finished it weeks ago. You're allowed to never start.

reasons: Tiger opposes Monkey — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a chair used as a shelf
signs.message: That chair's a shelf now. Leave the pile, stay horizontal.
